ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, titled “Food Webs.” The diagram contains organisms such as grass, grasshoppers, mice, rabbits, frogs, snakes, and owls. The explanatory text at the bottom says: “Arrows point to the animal doing the eating (predator),” meaning that the arrows point to the animal that is eating, that is, the predator. In the diagram, it can be seen that there is an arrow pointing to the snake, indicating that the snake eats other animals; at the same time, there is also an arrow from the snake's location pointing to the owl, with the arrow endpoint at the owl, indicating that the owl eats the snake. Reasoning: The question asks which organism both eats other animals and is eaten by other animals. According to the arrow rule, the snake has an arrow pointing to it, indicating that it is a predator and eats other animals; the snake also points to the owl through an arrow, indicating that the snake is eaten by the owl. Therefore, the organism that meets the condition is the snake.
